lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-ordered grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank. Blobs in the posterior region are larger and more widely spaced (lower spatial frequency) than the smaller, more densely packed spots observed in the cranial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the primary circular spots to form a matrix-like arrangement of high-luminance anchor nodes on the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and low-intensity shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin located in the ventral-center foreground exhibits a high spatial density of small-diameter, high-luminance spots that differ significantly in scale and distribution from the patterning on the main lateral trunk.
